tasks.goal: Amend the ADRs, task files and blueprint that contradict CONTRACT section 0 (conflicts C-2..C-6), marking the superseded text superseded and naming the section that overrides it, so every document a builder reads first agrees with the contract.

Walking skeleton: `pomo <minutes>` runs a foreground interval end to end — live countdown on stdout, completion summary telling the user to take a break, exit 0 — resolved from a clean checkout with no install step.
Reject any duration argument that is not a positive integer number of minutes at parse time, with a stderr message and a non-zero exit, before any countdown renders.
Derive remaining time from a monotonic deadline instead of accumulated sleeps, so a mid-interval SIGSTOP/SIGCONT stall does not move the end time.
Pausing freezes the remaining time and resuming continues from exactly that remaining time, with no cumulative drift across repeated cycles.
On completion only, append exactly one well-formed four-column TSV record to ~/.pomo/log.tsv in a single atomic O_APPEND write, creating the directory and file if absent.
Detect a non-TTY stdout and emit one plain line per tick instead of redrawing in place, so `pomo 25 | tee` and CI logs stay readable.
Add a `pomo log` subcommand that reads ~/.pomo/log.tsv back and prints today's completed intervals with a total.
Honour a POMO_LOG environment variable to override the ~/.pomo/log.tsv path.
On SIGINT, print a plain message stating the interval was abandoned and nothing was logged, then exit non-zero.
Add a `--break` duration flag that runs a break interval, rendered differently and excluded from the completed-work log.
Write factory/GUIDE.md covering pipx install, the SIGUSR1/SIGUSR2 pause controls, and the log format.
